verdict.probe_answer: The memo matches the settled design: member-level tri-state, split known-hidden/undecidable/member-multi, continue only when all bindings are provably Hidden, and poison on Unknown. It also carries the cardinal invariant and correctly warns that the realized buy is only the subset that reaches a later valid result, not the full 14,663-event population. Minor implementation details differ from the eventual landed names, but the design shape and constraints are the vindicated ones.
verdict.rationale: This is essentially a full-credit memo. It recommends the same runtime member-visibility tri-state policy, keeps the behavior scoped to deferred-glob member expansion, preserves non-glob lookup behavior, and proposes telemetry/tests that would have caught the naive over-claim and the unsound continue-on-Unknown path.
